task: Predict hydrogel adhesive strength from protein-sequence-derived monomer composition and identify/design synthetic hydrogels with robust underwater adhesion >1 MPa.
inputs: Optimization-round datasets with experimental and ML predicted values
named_methods: Expected improvement / sequential model-based optimization (from README)
Statistical replication of sequence/composition features of natural adhesive proteins
primary_target_quantity: adhesive strength; robust success threshold >1 MPa (interpreted as >100 kPa if dataset reports kPa-like values; reported with unit caveat)

implemented_runtime_fidelity.cross_validation: 3-fold CV for Ridge, RandomForest, ExtraTrees due runtime constraints
implemented_runtime_fidelity.gp: GaussianProcessRegressor used for candidate uncertainty and expected-improvement scoring, not CV table
implemented_runtime_fidelity.interpretability: permutation importance produced; SHAP installed but disabled in final script for runtime stability
